title: Update Log/Version 1.43.0
body:
This page contains all the changes made in Version 1.43.0.

Official update log

Added

  • A new store has appeared called Alan's AutoLogistics
  • Three new conveyors have been added to the game. The 4-Way Conveyor, Filter Conveyor, Alignment Conveyor
  • Fourty six new logic components have been added. A list in o particular order: Signal Lock, Zero Tick, Commander, XOR Gate, Greater Than Gate, Delay, Music Note, Laser Receiver, Laser, Lock, Button, Joystick, Marble (sic), Receiver, Frequency, Transmitter, Collider, Frequency Clock Electronic Billboard, LCD, Memory Cell, Daylight Sensor, Blocker, 14-Segment Display, Calculator, Pressure Pad, Binary Output, Tether, Privacy Glass, Material Laser, XAND Gate, Interactor, Binary Input, Weather Sensor, AND Gate, Randomizer, OR Gate, Number Interface, Proximity, Relay, Switch, Incrementor, Slider, T Flip-Flop, 7-Segment Display, NOT Gate, and the Sustainer
  • A new marble item has been added
  • Added a Smoke Emitter, now you can have cool fog!
  • A new color approaches! Introducing, the grey vehicle color. So special, wait- no.. so common!
  • The economy UI has been completely remade from the ground up
  • A new gamepass has been added, The Creative Wiring Gamepass!
  • A lot of performance additions have been added in attempt to help. The impact of these changes is unknown, more work is to be needed though! (sic)
  • New Playstation icons to replace Xbox when needed
  • A changelog summary now apepars for the first time you play that update, and can also be opened by clicking the TD logo in the bottom left
  • It's starting to get very cold! The grass colors will begin to shift

Fixed

  • Resolved a typo with the Clair de Lune music vinyl
  • The tutorial no longer gives finlay clover, now kelp for structures
  • The familiar place badge should now work again
  • Raw lavaslate on doors should no longer turn the door blue
  • The shopping vinyl now plays music
  • The statistic tool now shows plank and sawed wood correctly
  • Olive bark now is correctly displayed
  • You can no longer spam create save slots
  • Renwved collision from lanterns and ropes in the mines
  • Mobile can now correctly rotate items
  • Neon lights now lose their neon when powered Off

Changed

  • The loading content system is now accurate, faster, and will guarantee you load all assets in the game
  • The main menu music now is apart of the music sound group because I cannot take it anymore!
  • Sanded Kelp now follows the current grass color
  • Removed halloween items, decor, and other related content
  • Revamped delete mode completely, it's now a lot easier to delete objects!
  • Revamped unboxing structures via build mode, you can now open multiple in a row.
  • Reworked the visual appearance of the dragger
  • When driving a vehicle, the camera now is locked to the character head
  • Lowered the price of boxed water
  • Improved magma tree rate from Red Meteors
  • Lava cave wall requires more dynamite
  • Doors now only open in one direction, which can be changed by the user
  • Many UI elements now allow you to move your mouse when fully zoomed in
  • Elevators can now be scaled to a 1×4×1 size, and their max height has doubled
  • We sold out... the shop icon is now green

Changes

No changes in this update failed to make it into the patch notes.
